data.one_liner: Modbus client for ASCII/RTU over serial ports
data.what_it_does: Provides a Modbus client implementation that can send ASCII and RTU requests via a serial port. It supports auto‑connection, unit ID, timeouts, endianness, and a wide range of Modbus element types.
use_when: Communicating with industrial devices over serial Modbus (ASCII/RTU).
Building embedded or IoT applications that need Modbus serial access.
When you need a lightweight client with minimal dependencies for serial communication.
avoid_when: You only need TCP/UDP Modbus communication.
You are targeting a pure web environment without native serial support.
strengths: Minimal dependencies – only logging, libserialport, synchronized, and modbus_client.
Full endianness support and a rich set of Modbus element types.
Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux).
weaknesses: Requires native libserialport build or flutter_libserialport package.
No support for web or pure Dart VM without native binaries.
Documentation is limited to README and changelog; no extensive examples.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_libserialport to your Flutter project or build libserialport manually for Dart projects. No build_runner needed.
